workers.fuzz_run_description: Pinned six-root inventory and external legacy-template ownership scan
workers.command: git -C ROOT rev-parse PINNED_COMMIT; rg --files --hidden -g '!.git' ROOT -g '*.json.j2' -g '*.json.jinja' -g '*.json.jinja2'
workers.context_text: All six roots were available and pinned. The sc-compose O.4 root is locally clean apart from intentional fixtures. Twenty-five external production templates retain manually quoted placeholders without explicit mode; they are owned actionable release findings, not silently treated as clean.

test_inputs.outcome: PASS: 11 paths counted; expected fixtures classified

findings.minimal_template: atm-core: six .claude assignment JSON templates listed in docs/phase-O/evidence/o5-release-corpus.md
findings.minimal_input: hostile string value in a manually quoted placeholder
findings.observed_result: No explicit mode; 1.4.1 auto contract will reject quoted placeholders or risk double quoting
findings.expected_oracle: Migrate to explicit auto/bare values or explicitly pin legacy
findings.diagnostic: ERR_JSON_MODE_CONTRACT after migration / missing mode before migration
findings.requirement_follow_up: atm-core owner creates migration PR and reruns O5
findings.root_cause: Consumer templates predate the 1.4.1 mode contract
findings.recommended_fix: Migrate six paths in atm-core; add parser-backed tests
